name: IPS, Inc.
summary: IPS, Inc. provides IT and telecommunications services in Japan and the Philippines. The company provides internet and data carrier services; domestic telecommunications services comprising toll-free services, service for MVNO businesses, trunk, and value-added services, as well as software, infrastructure, and telecom services. It also offers CloudSigma, a cloud computing services; and AmeyoJ, a contact center management software, as well as business process outsourcing services. In addition, the company operates clinics, which are specialized in cosmetic dermatology, and myopia correction surgery, as well as medical checkup and health checkup centers for preventive medical care.
